Melzar's Maze '''zombies''' are two monsters found on the basement of [[Melzar's Maze]].

The zombie located in the middle of the room drops the [[Key (blue)|blue key]], required during the [[Dragon Slayer]] quest to enter the room where [[Melzar the Mad]] is located.
